mentions.name: Asheron's Call 1999 client server emulator
mentions.description: A server emulator that works with the original 1999 Asheron's Call game client, as well as the beta and preview clients. Built by reverse-engineering the launch-era network communication layer (which differs greatly from the end-of-retail 2015 client other emulators target), then restoring the abandoned or changed launch-era game mechanics and reconstructing the game world's original content and quests, using documented details from the game's running era together with tooling and Claude-assisted pattern matching.
mentions.problem: Existing Asheron's Call server emulators only work with the end-of-retail (2015) client, and the launch-era game mechanics, content, and quests had been abandoned or changed over time.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the past 6 months I've been working on building a server emulator that works with the original 1999 Asheron's Call game client (as well as the beta and preview clients we have access to).
mentions.author: AtticusTheGreat
